title: Blessed animal bladders hung on the fence line

tellings.quote: the the the Native Americans have been hanging these and blessing these animal bladders

plain: In 2016, Native Americans are said to have been hanging animal bladders along the fence at the edge of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, and blessing them. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's owner, tells it and credits the account to the security guards from the time of Bigelow, an earlier owner, as if the bladders were meant to guard against something on the land.
